title: Russia welcomes Trump’s revised US security strategy

title: Government waives part of a Biden-era fine against Southwest Airlines
summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation is waiving part of a fine assessed against Southwest Airlines after the company canceled thousands of flights during a winter storm in 2022.
